notes.title: Support Adventurers Added + Some System Changes
notes.notes:
Support adventurers have finally been added.
Thank you so much for your patience 💦

You can add up to 3 support adventurers by upgrading the inn.
They automatically return to dungeon exploration after fully recovering their health,
helping you gather resources more efficiently.

They use the same stats and tactics as your main adventurer,
but are slightly weaker when calculating attack and defense values.

Support adventurers explore randomly within 5 levels below your highest cleared stage.
The higher you progress, the more resources they’re likely to bring back.

Also, the damage calculation formula in battle has been slightly changed.
Previously fixed damage values are now randomized within a certain range.
Enemy monsters also had slight adjustments to damage and defense.

Thanks to all of you who provided feedback—I've learned so much from it.
I’ll keep doing my best to improve the game.
Your feedback is always welcome.
Thank you 😊

If any bugs appear, I’ll fix them first.
If all is stable, the next update will likely be Hard Mode dungeons.
I’ll do my best to bring it to you soon 🙂
